# Grounded Studio

> Independent Android studio from the Netherlands building practical tools and games. Three products: BuildExact (construction calculator and quoting app for contractors), FreshGarant (food expiry tracker that reduces household food waste), and Circuit Trace (minimalist logic puzzle game — 500+ handcrafted puzzles, 7 game modes, built-in Puzzle Editor with share codes, live on Google Play).

Grounded Studio ships native Android apps focused on being fast, offline-capable and privacy-friendly. Each product has a dedicated marketing site: **buildexact.app**, **freshgarant.app**, **circuittrace.app**. The hub at grounded-studio.app covers the studio, blog and calculator reference docs.

## Dedicated product sites

- **BuildExact**: [buildexact.app](https://buildexact.app) — the full product site
- **FreshGarant**: [freshgarant.app](https://freshgarant.app) — the full product site
- **Circuit Trace**: [circuittrace.app](https://circuittrace.app) — the full game site

## Products

- [BuildExact](https://grounded-studio.app/buildexact.html) · dedicated site [buildexact.app](https://buildexact.app): Construction calculator and quote-to-invoice app for Dutch and Belgian contractors. 11 material calculators (fence, tiles, paint, plasterboard, insulation, roof, stairs, paving, timber, bricks, concrete), project management, PDF quotes with digital signature.
- [FreshGarant](https://grounded-studio.app/freshgarant.html) · dedicated site [freshgarant.app](https://freshgarant.app): Food expiry tracker with AI fridge-scan, meal planning, price comparison and shopping lists. Helps households save on groceries and reduce food waste.
- [Circuit Trace](https://grounded-studio.app/games/circuit-trace.html) · dedicated site [circuittrace.app](https://circuittrace.app): Minimalist Android logic puzzle game, live on Google Play. 500+ handcrafted puzzles across 5 campaign modes — Circuit Trace (main campaign, 100 levels with progressive mechanics: stars, checkpoints, one-way diodes, portals, fill-every-cell), Classic (pure Flow-style, no mechanics), Diodes (one-way arrow puzzles), Portals (teleport puzzles), Arcade (all mechanics stacked). Plus Endless mode (infinite 5×5 to 9×9), Expert preview (random sector 8-9 taste), Daily Challenge, Weekly Puzzles, 60-second Time Trial. Built-in Puzzle Editor with 5-slot library — build 5×5 to 8×8 puzzles with diodes, share them via short codes (format CT-XXXXX-XXXXX-...), play codes friends send you. Google Play Games Services integration (23 achievements, leaderboards, cloud save). 6 languages (EN/NL/DE/FR/ES/PT). Interactive hint system and tutorial demo for new players. In-App Review API integration. Free with ads between campaign levels; optional €3.99 Remove Ads IAP. Package ID: com.game.circuittrace. Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.game.circuittrace

## Calculators (BuildExact)

Each page explains the inputs, formula, a worked example with real numbers, FAQ, and screenshots of the app. All bilingual NL/EN.

- [All calculators overview](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators.html)
- [Fence calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/schutting.html): posts, panels, cut panel, gates, corners
- [Tile calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/tegels.html): tiles, boxes, adhesive, grout, cutting waste by pattern
- [Paint calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/verf.html): litres, coats, coverage, primer, tin sizes
- [Plasterboard calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/gipsplaat.html): boards, screws, joint filler, tape, single or double layer
- [Insulation calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/isolatie.html): R-value, packs, fasteners, multi-layer stacking
- [Roof calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/dak.html): pitch angle, surface, tiles, battens for various roof types
- [Stairs calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/trap.html): steps, riser, tread, stringers, Blondel comfort, Dutch building code
- [Paving calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/bestrating.html): stones, sub-base, laying sand, edge restraint, pattern
- [Timber calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/hout.html): volume, planks, beams, stain and varnish by exterior surface
- [Brick calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/bakstenen.html): bricks, mortar, lintels, wall ties, auto-subtracted openings
- [Concrete calculator](https://grounded-studio.app/calculators/beton.html): m³ ready-mix, rebar kg and bar count, optional formwork
